title: Hinomori Shizuku — On A Flashy Stage〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think we're quite coordinated on this part now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Our practice sessions bore fruit!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And you've gotten much better at the moves you were having trouble with.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, it feels so nice to be complimented by Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, I'll have to work harder too, so that I can dance as well as Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's do this part together again when Airi can join us for practice next time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay! Then our next...
Wait, what? It's already so late?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Time really flies when you're enjoying yourself...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's stop here for today and get ready to go back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka, Shizuku.
Can I ask for your advice about something?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What is it? I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, what advice do you need?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I want to know...
What should I do in order to become an idol that's acknowledged by everyone?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Acknowledged... As in?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to be acknowledged by not just fellow group members, but everyone who watches our shows as well!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's quite a difficult goal to reach...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I thought so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There are many different ways to receive acknowledgement from others, but what made you think about this in the first place?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, it's because Haruka said I was a true idol too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was super happy when she said that to me, so I started wanting to have more and more people acknowledge me as a true idol to feel that happiness again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, I see.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I couldn't figure out how, no matter how hard I tried.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case... How about this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Put your ideal image of what an idol should be like ahead of what others think.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's the quickest way to becoming an idol that's acknowledged by everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My ideal image of what an idol should be like?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My ideal idol is...you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because I've always wanted to become an idol that brings hope to everyone like you do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This hasn't changed even now!
I fully intend to keep this ideal image in my heart forever!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What about Shizuku?
What's your ideal image of an idol? The one you want to become?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The ideal idol I want to become is...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What should we do for today's practice?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think we're ready to start practicing along to the music. I'll talk about it with everyone after school...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm? Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Long time no see. How are you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm fine, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, I'm really sorry I haven't been showing up at the archery club lately...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Don't worry about it, I know you're busy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, you seem to be really having fun lately.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You joined a new group, right?
I think that must be why you've been so full of life these days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You...may be right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When I quit being an idol, I felt like all the work I had done as an idol had been futile.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: People praised me, but only because of my looks...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I even started wondering if anyone actually saw the person I truly am inside.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The person...I truly am...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I mean, I understood that not everyone saw only what was on the outside, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I was still tormented about it...
I didn't know if being an idol like that had any meaning at all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I think I must have started feeling that way because I had lost sight of the image of the ideal idol I wanted to become.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh... You have a lot going on in your life too, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm doing fine now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The ideal idol I want to become...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I won't lose sight of her any longer.
